description: Charts and dashboards that read at a glance, survive a colour-blind reviewer, and never imply more certainty than the data has. Use this BEFORE writing any chart, graph, KPI tile, dashboard, or data visualization — in any library or in hand-drawn SVG/HTML — and whenever choosing chart colours, building a stat row, or deciding whether something should be a chart at all.
